control.box_constraint: Fresh native, layer-0 control, layer-5 control, and layer-5 candidate on one verified idle box, same day and immutable commit; run a second fixed-order round before promotion. Historical Source195 timings are evidence, not the matched control.

candidate.expected_diff: Scratch-only opt-in path for layer 5. Create two non-Parameter, non-persistent BF16 transposed mirrors from the ordinary current cache at the charged foreach refresh boundary; use those exact mirrors only as library forward inputs; preserve the original weights for the unchanged four-product BF16 backward and route gradients exactly once. Add explicit freshness, byte-identity, checkpoint-key, native-evaluation and contract markers. Do not modify root train.py, the frozen submission, prepare.py, scoring, vendor kernels, allocator, arithmetic, or compilation-region structure.

success_criteria.quality: No quality or BPB run is authorized. A later proposal may request one only after the complete-step gate passes twice.
success_criteria.throughput: In each of two same-host rounds, the layer-5 candidate must improve over its layer-5 control and be at least 3% faster in arithmetic-mean complete-step latency than both the fresh layer-0 reference and native reference. All mirror preparation, allocation, synchronization, forward, backward, optimizer, communication, and refresh costs are charged.
success_criteria.correctness: Exact mirror bytes and freshness; matched control/candidate outputs, saved tensors, losses, all input and weight gradients, FP32 accumulation and updates within existing bounds; no duplicate gradient path or stale cache; all native finite, causality, batch-independence, repetition, checkpoint restore, state-key and native-evaluation gates pass. The compiled candidate must remain joined and must remove the selected forward-local transpose producers.
